What if I told you that the mighty God of Thunder once had to dress up as a bride… to marry a giant?
And the funniest part? It was all Loki's plan!
One morning, Thor woke up to discover his magical hammer, Mjölnir, was missing.
A giant named Thrym had stolen it.
And he demanded something ridiculous in return.
He wanted to marry the beautiful goddess Freyja!
But Freyja refused.
So Loki came up with a crazy idea.
Dress Thor as Freyja and send him to the wedding!
Furious but desperate, Thor agreed.
Wearing a bridal gown and veil, he entered the giant's palace.
Everything was going perfectly…
Until dinner.
Thor ate an entire ox, eight salmon, and drank three barrels of mead!
The giant stared in disbelief.
"What kind of bride eats this much?!"
Loki quickly replied, "She's been so excited to marry you that she hasn't eaten for eight days!"
The giant believed him.
Finally, the wedding ceremony began.
The giant ordered Thor's stolen hammer to be placed in the bride's lap to bless the marriage.
And that's when everything went horribly wrong…
Thor grabbed the hammer.
Ripped off his disguise.
And unleashed his fury, killing Thrym and the giants gathered there!
The hilarious twist?
Thrym spent days preparing to marry the goddess of beauty…
But accidentally invited the God of Thunder to his own funeral!
